# Bayside IT Partners — Vendor Security Questionnaire (Their Answers)

> Fictional vendor for a practice assessment. Bayside filled this out on November 4, 2026, after the GRC Analyst sent it. Answers are copied exactly as Bayside wrote them.

**Vendor:** Bayside IT Partners, LLC · **Service:** Managed IT (after-hours support, server work, 24/7 EDR alert monitoring)
**Completed by:** D. Pruitt, Service Delivery Manager

| # | Question | Bayside's answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report? | "We have a SOC 2 Type I from 2023. Type II is on our roadmap." |
| 2 | How do your technicians log in to client systems? | "Through our shared client account (msp_tech) so any tech on shift can help. About 9 technicians use it." |
| 3 | Is MFA required for technician access to client systems? | "MFA is on for our own email. Client accounts follow the client's settings." |
| 4 | Where are your technicians located? | "Tampa office, plus overnight overflow support from our partner team in Manila, Philippines." |
| 5 | Are technicians U.S. persons? | "Tampa staff, yes. We'd have to check on the partner team." |
| 6 | Background checks for technicians? | "Yes for Tampa employees. The partner company handles their own." |
| 7 | How fast will you tell us about a security incident affecting our systems? | "Within 30 days of confirming an incident, per our standard terms." |
| 8 | Do you carry cyber insurance? | "Yes, $1,000,000 per claim." |
| 9 | Do you keep logs of what your technicians do in client systems? | "Our ticketing system records which tickets were worked." |
| 10 | When a technician leaves Bayside, how do you remove their access to client systems? | "They lose access to our ticketing and password vault. Because client accounts are shared, the password is rotated about once a year." |
| 11 | Have you had a security incident in the last 24 months? | "No." |
| 12 | Will you agree to protect CUI under DFARS 252.204-7012 if required? | "We'd need to review that with our attorney." |
